В глаголах ударение падает на первый слог» — EN version of the same page: "Syllable types: CV, CVC, CVRT. The stress in nouns is mixed, mobile. There are minimal pairs that differ in stress. In verbs, the stress falls on the first syllable."

audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: the deciding RU and EN sentences are verbatim and contiguous in the held / Phonetics section, final sentences). (2) Deciding source: an institutional web survey page (ILing RAS minlang, expert Ganenkov), grade 'open-text'. I located and fetched sources its primary: Kibrik & Kodzasov 1990 p. 335 (open Internet Archive scan with text layer; page image read), whose Chirag prosody item 2 is the same sentence word for word plus the examples the web page dropped: gále 'boy' ~ galé 'boys', arčúke 'rick' ~ arčuké 'ricks', 'in verbs stress falls on the 1st syllable'; p. 281 adds that all plural suffixes except -qale attract stress. ELAR's Chirag deposit page states the existing phonology of Chirag is this one page in Kibrik & Kodzasov 1990; minlang and Glottolog list no grammar. So the best available description is now held. sources.citation: Kibrik, A. E. & S. V. Kodzasov. 1990. Sopostavitel'noe izuchenie dagestanskix jazykov. Imja. Fonetika. Moskva: Izd-vo MGU. 368 pp. (Internet Archive item 20240226_20240226_1603, ABBYY text layer)
sources.quote: p. 335: «Ударение в именах разноместное, подвижное. Имеются минимальные пары, различающиеся ударением: gále "мальчик" – galé "мальчики", arčúke "скирда" – arčuké "скирды". В глаголах ударение падает на 1-й слог.» p. 281: «Все показ. Pl., кроме -qale, перетягивают на себя ударение. Конечная гласная основы обычно отпадает.» (page image of p. 335 checked visually; examples read from the scan, not scanned).
sources.locator: p. 335 (PDF p. 335), sec. 12 'Даргинский язык (с. Чираг)', СЛОГ И ПРОСОДИЯ item 2; also p. 281 (noun morphology sec. 12, Pl formation)
sources.note: Primary source of the minlang sentence our coding quotes; gives the actual minimal pairs (SG gále vs PL galé) and the rule that all plural suffixes except -qale attract stress — should replace the web page as deciding citation.
